digest.component_or_area: banking observer and completion evidence policy
propositions: The eval's observer counts only source=='tool' writes but the policy's per-criterion fallback snapshots (source='fallback') also durably bank progress, causing a mismatch between the model's voluntary banking cadence and the system's actual boundedness guarantee.

The 0707 dense-banking eval must be re-scoped from model-driven interleaved records to system-level boundedness, counting all durable bank writes (both genuine model records and policy fallback snapshots) regardless of actor source, excluding cache seeds.

The make_observed_upsert bookkeeping must be changed from filtering source=='tool' to recording any durable run-time bank write, and bounded_bank_gaps oracle must assert max_gap=3 evidence responses across all sources.

Unit regressions must prove: fallback-only transcripts pass the oracle, live run-32575679530 shape (fallbacks at 2/5 + genuine records from response 6) passes, and genuinely-unbounded transcripts (first durable bank after >3 responses) fail in final oracle form.
No production code changes required; only test-only modifications to four test files, with docstrings naming the ruled system-level contract and operator ruling citation.
